title: Doozy Vape Co Big Drip Berry Chew Shortfill E-Liquid 100ml
description: Big Drip Berry Chew from the Doozy Vape Co. is a delicious chewy candy flavour that features a blend of sweet, succulent Strawberries and tart, tangy Blackcurrants for an irresistibly smooth and fruity all-day vape. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle really helps your favourite e-liquid go the distance and comes with 25ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks .
